Lucy Flow · Coach

Who this class is for

For the woman who holds it all together. This hour is yours.

  • Women who look fine from the outside but feel flat, busy and a bit lost on the inside.
  • Women in a new chapter, after a separation, a career change or the little years, wondering who they are now.
  • Women with an idea, a business or a dream they keep putting off until “things calm down”.
  • Anyone who wants an hour to pause, think clearly and leave with one real next step.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why “stuck” is rarely a motivation problem

How the mental load quietly fills every day, and why another planner or a 5am alarm doesn’t fix it.

The stories that keep women playing small

The quiet beliefs about time, money and “not yet” that hold confidence back, and how to start questioning them.

Where your life feels out of line

A simple coaching exercise to see which part of life feels misaligned right now: work, relationships, health, home or you.

A five-minute grounding reset, live

A short follow-along practice to slow down and think clearly, that you can use any evening.

Your one small next step

How to choose a realistic first move, and what support looks like when you don’t want to do it alone.

Meet Lucy

Hi, I’m Lucy Flow

I coach women out of being stuck, and get them feeling alive. I work 1:1 with women through divorce, confidence, feeling stuck and starting a new business, and I run Burnout to Balance, a small 12-week coaching group for women.

Before coaching I spent years supporting women as a yoga teacher and doula, so I know how much women carry, and how much changes when someone finally makes space for them.

Script 1 · “Not motivation”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Most women I coach who feel stuck aren’t short on motivation.”

Body

“They’re carrying everything. The house, the work, the kids, everyone’s feelings. There’s simply no room left for them. Another planner won’t fix that. A pause, an honest look and one small step usually will.”

CTA

“I’m teaching exactly how in a free live masterclass. Replay included. Tap Sign up to save a seat.”

Shot: sitting on the floor against a white wall, natural light, white shirt and denim. On-screen text: “not motivation”.

Script 2 · “The modern village”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Women were never meant to do life alone.”

Body

“We used to have a village. Now so many of us hold it all together on our own and wonder why we feel flat. I’ve spent years supporting women as a doula and now as a coach, and the change starts the moment someone makes space for you.”

CTA

“So I’m making space: one free live hour. Tap Sign up and come and join me.”

Shot: walking through a bright room, then sitting down to talk to camera. Warm, slow, unscripted feel.

Script 3 · “One evening”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“What would change if you paused for one evening?”

Body

“Not a retreat. Not a life overhaul. Just one hour to step out of the mental load, look at which part of life feels out of line, and choose one realistic next step. That’s what we’ll do together in my free masterclass, From Stuck to Alive.”

CTA

“It’s free and live, with a replay. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: evening light, cup of tea, notebook on lap. Caption: “Coaching and education only.”
